initialBuild.packageCheck: The initial package stopped before publishing because the compiled lifecycle names and bytes had changed with the image queue. The accepted package has both corrected exact module pins.
initialBuild.protectedMetadata: Every restricted targetUrl object literal and every asset URL in both emitted modules matched the published v245 archive.

input: Windows and WSL each ran npm run verify and npm test in a dedicated checkout. The validation revision differs from the shipped application only in five test files and one legacy audit manifest. Application runtime, fonts, portraits, compiled module pins and production build scripts are identical.
